plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 62.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. Prerequisites transcribed from the official course descriptions: ASL 102 requires ASL 101 (the catalog also allows two years of high school ASL with a C or better, or a department competency exam); ASL 201 requires ASL 102; ASL 211 requires ASL 102; ASL 202 requires ASL 201; ASL 220 requires ASL 201 and ASL 211. ASL 124's official 'Prerequisite/Corequisite: ASL 102' is not modeled as a prerequisite because the official map co-enrolls ASL 124 with ASL 102 in the 2nd semester; ASL 212's official 'Prerequisite: ASL 201, 211' is likewise not modeled because the official map co-enrolls ASL 212 with ASL 201 and ASL 211 in the 3rd semester — see the official map and catalog. Dagger (†): some GE choice classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values. Choice slots model the official 'Select one' requirements; see choice notes.

courses.title: RHC GE 2 - Quantitative Reasoning
courses.choice_note: Select one per the official map's RHC GE 2 slot: STAT C1000 / STAT C1000H / PSY 190 / MATH 150 (encoded at the published 3.0 slot value; the map's dagger notes some classes may have higher units). The map's notes also allow FIN 101, MATH 060, MATH 073, MATH 140, MATH 160, MATH 170, MATH 175, MATH 180, MATH 190/H. STAT C1000 - Introduction to Statistics; STAT C1000H - Introduction to Statistics Honors; PSY 190 - Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences; MATH 150 - Survey of Mathematics.
